# Error codes

Every failure is a `LocationPickerError` with a stable `code`, a one-line `fix` and a `level`. Its message reads
`[location-picker] <what happened>. Fix: <fix>`.

- Failures that are not tied to a returned promise fire a cancelable `error` event (it does not bubble) on the
  element or the class instance. When no listener calls `preventDefault()` and no `onError` callback exists, it is
  logged at its `level`.
- Methods (`locate()`, `geocode()`, `lookupAddress()`) and the `ready` promise reject with the same error instead.
- `{placeholders}` in a message are filled in with the details of the failure.

The level below is the default for each code; a few cases override it (see
[`LocationPickerErrorCode`](api.md#locationpickererrorcode)).

| Code                                                  | Level    | Fix                                                                                             |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`TARGET_NOT_FOUND`](#target_not_found)               | `error`  | Pass an element, an id ("map") or a selector ("#map") that exists when the picker is created.   |
| [`INVALID_VALUE`](#invalid_value)                     | `warn`   | Pass "lat,lng" (latitude first), e.g. "48.8584,2.2945", or {lat, lng}.                          |
| [`INVALID_OPTION`](#invalid_option)                   | `error`  | Check the option name and value against the LocationPickerOptions docs.                         |
| [`ENGINE_MISSING`](#engine_missing)                   | `error`  | Load Leaflet first, pass engine: L, or remove engine-url="none".                                |
| [`ENGINE_LOAD_FAILED`](#engine_load_failed)           | `error`  | Check the network and the CSP script-src, or self-host the engine and set engine-url.           |
| [`ENGINE_CSS_MISSING`](#engine_css_missing)           | `warn`   | Load leaflet.css on the page, set engine-css-url, or allow https://cdn.jsdelivr.net.            |
| [`API_KEY_MISSING`](#api_key_missing)                 | `error`  | Add api-key="YOUR_KEY", or load the Google Maps JS API before the picker.                       |
| [`GOOGLE_AUTH_FAILED`](#google_auth_failed)           | `error`  | Check the key's HTTP-referrer restrictions, billing, and that Maps JavaScript API is enabled.   |
| [`MAP_ID_REQUIRED`](#map_id_required)                 | `warn`   | Set map-id (mapId), or use marker="pin".                                                        |
| [`GEOCODER_MISMATCH`](#geocoder_mismatch)             | `error`  | Use the provider's paired geocoder; Google's terms forbid mixing Google and non-Google content. |
| [`GEOCODER_MISSING`](#geocoder_missing)               | `error`  | Remove geocoder: false, or pass a geocoder.                                                     |
| [`GEOCODER_FAILED`](#geocoder_failed)                 | `warn`   | Check the network and the service's rate limits; use your own geocoder in production.           |
| [`GEOLOCATION_UNSUPPORTED`](#geolocation_unsupported) | `warn`   | Serve the page over HTTPS, and add allow="geolocation" to a containing iframe.                  |
| [`GEOLOCATION_DENIED`](#geolocation_denied)           | `warn`   | Allow location access in the browser's site settings, or pick the point on the map.             |
| [`GEOLOCATION_UNAVAILABLE`](#geolocation_unavailable) | `warn`   | Try again (Wi-Fi helps), or pick the point on the map.                                          |
| [`GEOLOCATION_TIMEOUT`](#geolocation_timeout)         | `warn`   | Try again, or raise geolocation.timeout.                                                        |
| [`ABORTED`](#aborted)                                 | `silent` | Nothing to fix: the picker was destroyed or a newer request replaced this one.                  |

## `TARGET_NOT_FOUND`

- **Level:** `error` (logged with `console.error` when unhandled)
- **Message:** no element matches {target}
- **Fix:** Pass an element, an id ("map") or a selector ("#map") that exists when the picker is created.

## `INVALID_VALUE`

- **Level:** `warn` (logged with `console.warn` when unhandled)
- **Message:** {value} is not a coordinate
- **Fix:** Pass "lat,lng" (latitude first), e.g. "48.8584,2.2945", or {lat, lng}.

## `INVALID_OPTION`

- **Level:** `error` (logged with `console.error` when unhandled)
- **Message:** invalid option {option}
- **Fix:** Check the option name and value against the LocationPickerOptions docs.

## `ENGINE_MISSING`

- **Level:** `error` (logged with `console.error` when unhandled)
- **Message:** the map engine is not loaded
- **Fix:** Load Leaflet first, pass engine: L, or remove engine-url="none".

## `ENGINE_LOAD_FAILED`

- **Level:** `error` (logged with `console.error` when unhandled)
- **Message:** the map engine could not be loaded from {url}
- **Fix:** Check the network and the CSP script-src, or self-host the engine and set engine-url.

## `ENGINE_CSS_MISSING`

- **Level:** `warn` (logged with `console.warn` when unhandled)
- **Message:** the map engine CSS is missing
- **Fix:** Load leaflet.css on the page, set engine-css-url, or allow https://cdn.jsdelivr.net.

## `API_KEY_MISSING`

- **Level:** `error` (logged with `console.error` when unhandled)
- **Message:** Google Maps needs an API key
- **Fix:** Add api-key="YOUR_KEY", or load the Google Maps JS API before the picker.

## `GOOGLE_AUTH_FAILED`

- **Level:** `error` (logged with `console.error` when unhandled)
- **Message:** Google Maps rejected the API key
- **Fix:** Check the key's HTTP-referrer restrictions, billing, and that Maps JavaScript API is enabled.

## `MAP_ID_REQUIRED`

- **Level:** `warn` (logged with `console.warn` when unhandled)
- **Message:** marker="advanced" needs a Google map ID; showing the CSS pin
- **Fix:** Set map-id (mapId), or use marker="pin".

## `GEOCODER_MISMATCH`

- **Level:** `error` (logged with `console.error` when unhandled)
- **Message:** this geocoder may not be shown on a {provider} map
- **Fix:** Use the provider's paired geocoder; Google's terms forbid mixing Google and non-Google content.

## `GEOCODER_MISSING`

- **Level:** `error` (logged with `console.error` when unhandled)
- **Message:** no geocoder is available
- **Fix:** Remove geocoder: false, or pass a geocoder.

## `GEOCODER_FAILED`

- **Level:** `warn` (logged with `console.warn` when unhandled)
- **Message:** the geocoding request failed
- **Fix:** Check the network and the service's rate limits; use your own geocoder in production.

## `GEOLOCATION_UNSUPPORTED`

- **Level:** `warn` (logged with `console.warn` when unhandled)
- **Message:** geolocation is not available here
- **Fix:** Serve the page over HTTPS, and add allow="geolocation" to a containing iframe.

## `GEOLOCATION_DENIED`

- **Level:** `warn` (logged with `console.warn` when unhandled)
- **Message:** location permission was denied
- **Fix:** Allow location access in the browser's site settings, or pick the point on the map.

## `GEOLOCATION_UNAVAILABLE`

- **Level:** `warn` (logged with `console.warn` when unhandled)
- **Message:** the position could not be determined
- **Fix:** Try again (Wi-Fi helps), or pick the point on the map.

## `GEOLOCATION_TIMEOUT`

- **Level:** `warn` (logged with `console.warn` when unhandled)
- **Message:** finding the position took too long
- **Fix:** Try again, or raise geolocation.timeout.

## `ABORTED`

- **Level:** `silent` (never logged)
- **Message:** the operation was aborted
- **Fix:** Nothing to fix: the picker was destroyed or a newer request replaced this one.
